name: strategy-factory-r4-pre-oos-integrity-audit
purpose: Reject-only robustness and integrity audit of the already-frozen 32 R4 candidates before any protected OOS request. This step may reject candidates but may not retune, replace, optimize, or add candidates.

audit_gates.strict_year_boundary: Forward outcome for a signal is valid only when the target bar remains in the same calendar year as the signal bar. This removes any 2024-to-2025 horizon spillover without changing a rule.
audit_gates.purged_2024_edge: Frozen conditional edge must remain strictly positive after the same-year outcome purge.
audit_gates.purged_2025_edge: Frozen conditional edge must remain strictly positive; 2026 is unavailable to the loader and cannot contribute outcomes.
audit_gates.quarter_sign_consistency_2025: Each 2025 calendar quarter must have a strictly positive frozen conditional edge with the minimum sample gates below.
audit_gates.daily_block_bootstrap_2025: Resample whole UTC calendar days with replacement; the 5th percentile of the frozen conditional-edge distribution must be strictly above zero. This is a dependence/stability stress test, not new independent confirmation.

pass_rule: A candidate survives only if every audit gate passes. Zero survivors closes this R4 frozen shortlist. One or more survivors may advance only to a separately committed protected-OOS preregistration; this audit itself cannot authorize 2026.
interpretation: R4 already used 2025 for confirmation. These checks are conservative reject-only integrity/robustness checks and must never be described as new independent evidence. No parameter or candidate substitution is allowed after seeing audit results.
protected_2026_policy: FORBIDDEN. Do not read, inspect, summarize, hash market-data contents, or use any row dated 2026 or later. Explicit owner approval plus a separate committed preregistration are required before protected OOS.
